description: Produces candidate findings for one reviewer lens. It is one logical Agent instantiated per reviewer role, not one Agent per lens: the lens ledger stays REVIEWER_ROLES in src/lib/reviewer-orchestrator.mjs, and the river-review-* agent skills are skills it may use rather than additional Agents.

implementedBy.note: The lens ledger this Agent is instantiated over.
Produces the candidate findings for one lens.
